Title: 2025-08-05 Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: === Heroes: Alarak ===
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Alarak ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Alarak's Overwhelming Power to grant bonus Healing from non-Heroes.

=== Heroes: Auriel ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Auriel's Detainment Strike to not properly detect path blockers in some situations.

=== Heroes: Dehaka ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Dehaka's Drag to not work correctly on Rooted targets.

=== Heroes: Diablo ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Diablo's Shadow Charge to not properly detect path blockers in some situations.

=== Heroes: Hogger ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Hogger's Staggering Blow to not properly detect path blockers in some situations.

=== Heroes: Johanna ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Knockback's speed of Johanna's Condemn increased from 13.75 to 18.

=== Heroes: Kerrigan ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Knockback's speed of Kerrigan's Primal Grasp increased from 13.75 to 18.
  • [Undocumented] Knockback's duration of Kerrigan's Primal Grasp reduced from 0.375 to 0.3125 seconds.

=== Heroes: Li-Ming ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Knockback's speed of Li-Ming's Repulsion increased from 6.7 to 10.1.
  • [Undocumented] Knockback's duration bonus of Li-Ming's Repulsion reduced from 0.1875 to 0.125 seconds.

=== Heroes: Lúcio ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the tooltip for Lúcio's Subwoofer to display an incorrect Knockback's bonus distance.

=== Heroes: Muradin ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Muradin's Haymaker to not work correctly on Rooted targets.

=== Heroes: Raynor ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Knockback's speed applied of Raynor's Penetrating Round's middle hit increased from 8.5 to 12.5.

=== Heroes: Stitches ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Stitches's Hook to not work correctly on Rooted targets.

=== Heroes: Tyrael ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] The tooltip for Tyrael's Reciprocate now correctly says "Tyrael" instead of "Tyreal".
